title: Fast shipping, less than high quality, easy to assemble
text:
Fast shipping, less than high quality, easy to assemble. I ordered this for my teenager and she's happy with it, but I was a little disappointed in the quality. First, I want to say that aside from putting the mirror on, this was very easy to put together (yes, it comes in pieces). The legs for the table itself are just screwed on, and that's it. You do need 2 people to put the mirror together. The drawers are much smaller than they appear when looking at it. When you open a drawer the width of the drawer itself is about 2 inches smaller than the front face of the drawer, so you can't fit much in them. The stool is VERY small, and the legs beneath it seem like they are going to break right off, because they tend to angle inward slightly (probably because they are not cut well to fit when you screw on the legs) and there were several pulls of thread on the fabric, I had to cut them all off. I am expecting to have to replace the stool anyway, at some point. The wood is obviously compressed particleboard (or whatever you call it) so be careful when you put in the screws for the mirror and the legs on the stool.

Also, the packaging wasn't great, be careful when you open the box because the drawers are not held in place at all, they will fly right out when you try to pull it out of the box or flip it over after putting the legs on.

The one thing I really liked was that the shipping was super fast! I received it the day after I placed the order.
